notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome only, one dedicated tab; no HTTP client, proxy or reader was used at any point. robots.txt names no Claude/anthropic agent and disallows only customer-area/watch-list paths, so extraction is permitted. LANGUAGE: connox.com is Connox's ENGLISH storefront (html lang=en, body data-channel=100005) and was used throughout; all sub-category names below are the site's own English labels, so no translation was needed. Links are the canonical www.connox.com origin URLs. TREE: taken from the site's own mega-menu, which is present in the served HTML. Products > Furniture gives three levels (department > group > leaf: Seating furniture, Tables, Storage furniture, Bedroom furniture, Screens, Entryway Furniture), plus Products > Outdoor > Outdoor Furniture and Products > Kids > Children furniture. The Rooms mega-menu (Living Room, Bedroom, Dining Room, Kitchen, Bathroom, Hallway, Home Office, Kids' Room, Balcony & Garden) was walked as well and proved to be pure cross-links into the same category nodes; it contributed only two genuinely new furniture leaves, Serving trolley (from Kitchen > Kitchen furniture) and Clothes ladders (from Bathroom > Bathroom furniture). A regex sweep of every /categories/ link in the nav for furniture-like slugs found nothing else in scope. Group hubs (furniture.html, seating-furniture.html, tables.html, storage-furniture.html, entryway-furniture.html) and the /tag/ hubs (bedroom-furniture, outdoor-furniture, children-furniture) all have extractable children and are therefore emitted as grouping rows only, per the deepest-URL rule. QTY: the prior Home-Decor pass got no counts because Connox category pages are client-side rendered. In a real browser they render 'N Items' into div.total-item-count, and that rendered header is the source of truth here. The React app populates it from the site's own listing endpoint api.connox.io/v1/shop/100005/items with view=search, currencyCode=EUR and categoryId=<id>, field result.totalSearchHits (the prior pass's attempts failed only because they omitted view=search). Each page's categoryId was read from its own served HTML (body id="C<id>" and the dataLayer CategoryId), and the endpoint was called by same-origin XHR from the loaded Connox page - never from outside the browser. SANITY CHECKS: the API value was checked against the rendered div.total-item-count on five pages spanning the range - Chairs 1573, Side tables 1044, Wall coat racks 196, Containers 121, Shelves 10 - and matched exactly every time. All 50 leaf counts were then read a second time in a separate pass and every value was identical, so no session drift. Counts vary widely per node (4 to 1573), so there is no site-wide-constant failure mode. All 50 leaf URLs were re-fetched and checked against their own link rel=canonical and their final response URL: all 50 resolve to themselves with no redirect. EXCLUSIONS: 'Shelves' (the nav lists it under Storage furniture at /categories/furniture/shelves.html) was dropped after inspection - it redirects to /categories/kitchenware/shelves.html, its breadcrumb is Categories > Kitchenware, and its 10 products are etageres, tiered trays and cake stands, i.e. serveware, not shelving. Also excluded: Table tops and Table legs & table trestles (furniture parts); Mattresses and Folding mattresses (bedding); Wall shelves (/tag/wall-racks.html, an Inspiration topic page and wall decor); Bottle racks (kitchenware); Coat hooks / wall hooks (368 items, hardware); Umbrella stands (household accessory, breadcrumb Household); Keyboards and key fobs; Parasols (sun protection, although the site lists them under Outdoor Furniture); Play tents (toys); Step stools / folding ladders (household ladders); Storage baskets and storage boxes (Storage task, not furniture); Pet beds; and all lighting, mirror, textile, planter, fireplace and tableware departments. The /tag/design-sofa-bed.html 'Sofa bed' listing (145 items) was excluded as a landing page: its breadcrumb is Inspiration > Interior Design Topics, not a catalogue category, and its products are cross-listed from Sofas and Beds. INCLUDED AFTER INSPECTION: 'Containers & roll containers' was opened and verified to be Kartell Componibili modular storage units and cabinets on castors, i.e. storage furniture, despite its Home Accessories breadcrumb. OVERLAP: Connox cross-lists products across nodes by internal category id, so sibling counts overlap by design - the Chairs total of 1573 includes 157 garden chairs, and Garden chairs sits at /outdoor/outdoor-chairs-outdoor-benches.html and overlaps Garden benches. Each figure is nevertheless exactly the number the site itself publishes for that node; nothing was summed, derived or apportioned.
